meta.name: Uyir
meta.description: SI Ajeeb, a probationary officer posted in a Kerala town, investigates the mysterious death of an unidentified woman whose decomposed body is found in a well. Despite a lack of evidence and official support, he relentlessly pursues the truth with the help of ASI Joy while battling his own psychological struggles. Inspired by true events, the film follows his quest for justice in a case that changes his life forever.
